SELECT 
    w_state, 
    i_item_id, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN (d_date < '2001-05-02') THEN cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr_sub.total_refunded, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS sales_before, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN (d_date >= '2001-05-02') THEN cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr_sub.total_refunded, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS sales_after 
FROM 
    catalog_sales 
JOIN 
    warehouse ON catalog_sales.cs_warehouse_sk = warehouse.w_warehouse_sk 
JOIN 
    item ON item.i_item_sk = catalog_sales.cs_item_sk 
JOIN 
    date_dim ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk 
LEFT JOIN 
    (SELECT cs_order_number, cs_item_sk, SUM(cr_refunded_cash) AS total_refunded 
     FROM catalog_returns 
     GROUP BY cs_order_number, cs_item_sk) AS cr_sub 
    ON catalog_sales.cs_order_number = cr_sub.cs_order_number 
    AND catalog_sales.cs_item_sk = cr_sub.cs_item_sk 
WHERE 
    item.i_current_price BETWEEN 0.99 AND 1.49 
    AND date_dim.d_date BETWEEN '2001-04-02' AND '2001-06-01' 
GROUP BY 
    w_state, i_item_id 
ORDER BY 
    w_state, i_item_id 
LIMIT 100
